Garbage in, garbage out — build the dataset, watch the forecast

Pick an asset, then strip its data down — take fewer oil samples, skip lab tests — and watch the same trained model try to forecast it. The right-hand panel shows how far you can trust the result. Every asset here uses invented, synthetic data — no real customer information is shown.

    How to read the charts

    • I. Fluid survival forecast — chance the oil is still healthy over the next year.
    • II. Next-sample forecast — the model's predicted next lab reading with its 10–90% band.
    • III. Chance the oil is still healthy — at 3, 6 and 12 months (green = good, red = act).
    • IV. How this asset compares — its 1-year health next to the other demo assets.
